headline: Zurich Malaysia rolls out AI tool for motor bodily injury claims
body: Zurich Malaysia has rolled out an AI-enabled decision-support tool for motor third-party bodily injury (TPBI) claims, working with Lawdify Pte Ltd to deploy it. More than 80% of its claims handlers use the tool daily, and 90% report time savings on case review and preparation, according to an internal survey.
note: Zurich Malaysia says the motor segment's combined ratio has been above 100% for a fourth consecutive year, a level that indicates an underwriting loss.

evidence.text: Zurich Malaysia has rolled out an AI-enabled decision-support tool for motor third-party bodily injury (TPBI) claims.
More than 80% of its claims handlers use the tool daily, while 90% report time savings on case review and preparation, according to an internal survey.
The insurer is working with Lawdify Pte Ltd to deploy the tool, which uses an intelligence layer drawing on jurisdiction-specific insights into injuries, fraud and settlement data.
Malaysia's motor insurance segment recorded an underwriting loss of RM289.3 million in 2025, according to the General Insurance Association of Malaysia (PIAM).
The segment's combined ratio stood at 103%, measuring claims and underwriting expenses against premiums earned.
A ratio above 100% indicates an underwriting loss.
Zurich Malaysia said this was the fourth consecutive year the segment's combined ratio remained above that level.
